text:
Catherine lives in a white house overlooking the sweeping brown tides of the river.. She helped me clean up my flat with a devotion which said that she felt small flats were altogether more romantic than large houses. We drank tea, and talked mainly about Philip, who, being 15, has pure stern tastes in everything from food to music. Catherine Lives in a white house
